title: 第2576章 提升灵气浓度第2575章 一个也看不懂
slug: 灵气复苏我有个吞噬系统
content_zh:
眼前的白裙女子便是宋依雪的同门师姐，名为宋若薇。
岚雪宗的功法特殊，只收女弟子。
这里对于千星阁阁主来说也算是娘家了。
正好这里距离日月观的位置比较远，在无尽雪山底下埋入一道灵石矿脉也比较合适。
“我不是为了雪儿来的，总之一会儿宋师姐你就知道原因了。”
千星阁阁主故作神秘，卖了一个关子。
“先别卖弄关子了，跟我一起进去见师父吧，要是让师父知道我一直把你晾在宗门外，肯定少不了数落我一通。”
宋若薇根本不吃千星阁阁主这一套，只觉得千星阁阁主过来是有要紧事。
“不急。”千星阁阁主摇了摇头。
同时他也在心中纳闷，怎么丘凌风还不跟过来。
嗡！
就当他如此想着的时候，一颗星子出现在他身旁，随后丘凌风的身影显现。
宋若薇看到突然现身，还是长发造型的丘凌风时，稍微一楞，扭头看着千星阁阁主，眼神带着询问，“盟主，这又是怎么回事？”
“他是另一个时空的我，也可以说是未来的我。”
说句实话，千星阁阁主已经不再想重复这一套话术了。
但是没办法，谁让宋若薇的身份摆在那里呢？
该解释的还是要解释。
等下他还要再跟岚雪宗宗主解释一趟呢。
宋若薇被千星阁阁主的说辞弄的一愣，然后她摇了摇头，道：“算了，我还是先带你去见师父吧。”
随后，宋若薇就在前面引路。

丘凌风和千星阁阁主紧随其后。
“你怎么这么慢啊？”
千星阁阁主小声问道。
“和莉莎她们聊了一会儿，耽误了一点时间。”
丘凌风懒洋洋的说了一句，“我看这宗门里的女子都修炼了《寒凝玄功》，是宋依雪的师门么？”
“对，此地便是岚雪宗。门中功法特殊，只有女子可以修炼，门中的女子基本上都是孤儿或者有资质的修炼世家筛选出来的女弟子，所以每一个都实力不俗。”
“一般而言，像雪儿这种资质顶尖的女弟子，都会成为宗门传承人，终生不外嫁，当初雪儿也是为了我，放弃了传承人的资格，所以从心底上来说，我对岚雪宗还是抱有几分愧意的。”
千星阁阁主耐心地说道。
“其实你也不要有什么心理负担，宋依雪的特殊体质、专属神通以及功法，每时每刻都会在她体内堆叠寒气，年龄越大，对她身体的负担越大，没有你吸收寒气的话，估计她早就死了。”
丘凌风瞥了一眼千星阁阁主，说道。
以他的眼力，根本不难看出。
宋依雪如果没有千星阁阁主日复一日的吸收寒气，恐怕早就香消玉殒了。
又哪能活到如今这个时候？
而且，丘凌风也相信，能看出来宋依雪隐患的，不止他一个。
岚雪宗内的众人，估计也清楚宋依雪的问题。
content_en:
The woman in the white dress in front of her is Song Yixue's fellow senior sister named Song Ruowei.
The Lanxue Sect has a special technique and only accepts female disciples.
For the master of Qianxing Pavilion, this place is also considered his natal home.
It just so happens that this place is relatively far from the Sun and Moon Temple, so it would be more suitable to bury a vein of spirit stone under the endless snow-capped mountains.
"I'm not here for Xue'er. Anyway, Senior Sister Song, you'll know the reason soon."
The master of the Qianxing Pavilion pretended to be mysterious and betrayed it.
"Stop showing off for now. Come in with me to see the master. If the master knows that I have been keeping you outside the sect, he will definitely give me a scolding."
Song Ruowei didn't take the Qianxing Pavilion Pavilion Master's trick at all, she just felt that the Qianxing Pavilion Pavilion Master came over because of important matters.
"There's no rush." ​​The master of Qianxing Pavilion shook his head.
At the same time, he was also wondering why Qiu Lingfeng didn't follow him.
Buzz!
Just when he was thinking this, a star appeared next to him, and then Qiu Lingfeng's figure appeared.
When Song Ruowei saw Qiu Lingfeng who suddenly appeared with long hair, she was slightly startled and turned to look at the Pavilion Master of Qianxing Pavilion with a questioning look in her eyes, "Leader, what's going on?"
"He is me in another time and space, or you can say he is me in the future."
To be honest, the master of Qianxing Pavilion no longer wants to repeat this routine.
But there is no way, who put Song Ruowei's identity there?
What needs to be explained still needs to be explained.
He would have to explain it to the master of Lanxue Sect later.
Song Ruowei was stunned by the words of the master of Qianxing Pavilion, then she shook her head and said: "Forget it, I'll take you to see the master first."
Afterwards, Song Ruowei led the way.
Qiu Lingfeng and the master of Qianxing Pavilion followed closely behind.
"Why are you so slow?"
The master of Qianxing Pavilion asked softly.
"I chatted with Lisa and the others for a while and wasted a little time."
Qiu Lingfeng said lazily, "I think all the women in this sect have practiced the "Han Ning Xuan Gong". Are they Song Yixue's sect?"
"Yes, this is the Lanxue Sect. The martial arts in the sect are special and only women can practice them. The women in the sect are basically orphans or female disciples selected from qualified cultivating families, so each of them is very powerful."
"Generally speaking, female disciples with top qualifications like Xue'er will become the heirs of the sect and will not marry outside the family throughout their lives. Xue'er also gave up her qualifications as the heir for me, so from the bottom of my heart, I still feel a little guilty towards the Lanxue Sect."
The master of Qianxing Pavilion said patiently.
"Actually, you shouldn't have any psychological burden. Song Yixue's special physique, exclusive magical powers, and skills will accumulate cold energy in her body every moment. The older she gets, the greater the burden on her body. Without you to absorb the cold energy, she would have died long ago."
Qiu Lingfeng glanced at the master of Qianxing Pavilion and said.
With his eyesight, it was not difficult to see at all.
Song Yixue would have died long ago if the master of Qianxing Pavilion had not absorbed the cold air day after day.
How could he survive until now?
Moreover, Qiu Lingfeng also believed that he was not the only one who could see Song Yixue's hidden dangers.
Everyone in the Lanxue Sect is probably aware of Song Yixue's problem.
